# AGENTS.md

## Agents

### agent-01

Synthetic agent 1 used only to pad this fixture to a realistic size for the NFR-PERF-01 benchmark (BenchmarkRun_LargeFile in internal/lint/rules).

**Role:** Performs a narrow, well-defined task as part of a larger benchmark fixture; not a real project agent.

**Responsibilities:**
- Exercise the parser across many repeated H3 blocks
- Exercise agent-name uniqueness checking (S004) across many distinct names
- Provide enough line volume to approximate a 500-line AGENTS.md

**Tools:** `go test`, `go build`

**Context:** `testdata/scan/perf/large.md` (this file, block 1)
